jobs.name: shark-1
jobs.idea: A long low wedge shaped body like a spearhead, sharp and aggressive. A giant sickle shaped dorsal fin like a curved blade. A ridge of long thin quills down its back, raked backwards like arrows ready to fire. A heavy crescent tail. An oversized jaw gaping open with rows of jagged bone white teeth and a dark red mouth.

jobs.name: shark-2
jobs.idea: A thick heavy armoured body like a battering ram, covered in overlapping bony plates like an armadillo. A short broad dorsal fin like an axe head. A row of short heavy bone plates down its back. A club shaped tail with spikes. A huge square shovel jaw gaping open with rows of jagged bone white teeth for digging through sand, and a dark red mouth.

jobs.name: shark-3
jobs.idea: A long serpentine body like an eel, curved in an S shape, lean and fast. A tall thin dorsal fin like a sail. A crest of long jagged bone blades down its whole spine. A long whip tail ending in a forked fin. A narrow pointed snout with a gaping jaw full of long needle teeth and a dark red mouth.

jobs.name: bear-1
jobs.idea: A hulking hunched body with massive high shoulders and a small head, like a gorilla. One front arm is a giant bionic grappling claw bigger than its head, with three long hooked steel fingers.

jobs.name: bear-2
jobs.idea: It stands upright on its hind legs like a giant warrior, a tall block shaped body, roaring. One arm is a giant bionic grappling claw raised high, with three long hooked steel fingers. Steel vertebrae run down its back.

jobs.name: bear-3
jobs.idea: A long low body like a wolverine, crouched to pounce, steel bones breaking out along its back like a ridge of spikes. One front arm is a long bionic arm ending in a huge two pronged steel pincer dragging on the ground.
